title: Qualify private-feed immutable publication controller for the first Math NuGet package
commitMessage: test: qualify Math immutable local NuGet publisher rehearsal

contribution.summary: Qualify a Math-owned controller that uses published Dw.Tools.NuGet for a no-overwrite real-package publication rehearsal in a disposable feed, without writing NUGET_LOCAL.
contribution.value: Repack actual standalone dw.quantities in an isolated local workspace, verify archive and DLL hashes, and exercise shared publisher success, collision, digest mismatch and cancellation refusal while preserving RS135's immutable proof.
debtChanges: The shared NuGet publisher is exercised only on a disposable feed. A physical NUGET_LOCAL release and its independent recipient verification are later explicit actions.
The dated 20260.20261102.1001 candidate can be physically published only on its actual release date with the exact RS135 bytes; otherwise requalify a new calendar version.
Private owner rights are retained without asserting a public license or clearing all third-party content; package readme and notices require separate review.
No previous immutable Math release exists, so installed-package rollback and crash recovery remain unqualified; the direct source pathway is not a physical NuGet rollback.
contribution.nextAction: After successful RS136 and explicit rights/date review, invoke the separate guarded --publish action for the exact immutable dw.quantities candidate; independently verify the published binary and reconcile its DWF receipt before dependent packages.
